$description: The rasters of the redesign that had no SVG: where each SVG comes from in the Figma file (VLC Redesign (Community), the same node ids) and how close it is. qt_vs_png: QtSvg 6.8 against the PNG (mean alpha, 0-255; shape: the same of 3 x 3 averages); qt_vs_figma: against Figma's own 1x render of the symbol (frame 42:356), when the state shows the whole symbol in its colours. how: frame symbol (cut from the SVG export of 42:356), outlined stroke (the stroke outline Figma fills, strokeGeometry clipped to fillGeometry: the export draws these boolean shapes as their outline only), node export (groups of an onboarding node export), composed (drawn here: not in the file, or simple geometry).
